Reporting to the UCHRI Director, this position directs and administers UCHRI’s independent research, grants, training, academic, publicly engaged, and other programs and initiatives, holding full accountability for their administrative, programmatic, and budgetary operations, including administration of the grants program, oversight of the grant selection process, and reporting. The incumbent identifies, develops, pursues, and manages funding opportunities and revenue streams, including research grants, private philanthropy, and advancement partnerships, to support UCHRI’s mission, and participates in advanced program budgeting and accounting processes, including grant design. The position supervises UCHRI staff, ensuring accountability and stewardship of departmental resources, and oversees research programs and administrative operations, including hiring, staff evaluation, and facilities. The position assesses the ongoing effectiveness of UCHRI’s programs and initiatives across the UC system and implements changes to program content, policies, and procedures accordingly. The incumbent serves on committees representing UCHRI, co-directs the Institute’s short- and long-term planning processes, and represents UCHRI in university, national, and international contexts through events, meetings, conferences, festivals, and workshops. The role facilitates interdisciplinary collaboration among departments, managers, and external constituencies across all ten UC campuses, serves as liaison to all ten campus humanities centers, and coordinates with the UC Humanities Consortium, including helping to plan and run its monthly meetings. The position develops and participates in professional conferences and other occasional events and serves as lead researcher and administrator on national grants. The incumbent leads and carries out communications regarding UCHRI’s research programs, grants, events, and accomplishments for the public, press, foundations, government, and the UC community.
Thorough knowledge of administrative, budgetary, human resources and financial principles and practices.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Strong ability to think creatively and independently on concepts requiring advanced analytical skills.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with diverse groups to achieve results.
Strong ability to work collaboratively with internal and external peers and managers.
